description: This source file implements a firmware cutter tool for Arcadyan W921V devices. It extracts and decompresses firmware parts from a binary firmware image, identifying sections via magic numbers and handling LZMA compressed data.

methods.name: part_type
methods.description: Determines the firmware part type based on an ID, returning the corresponding filename.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that loads the firmware file, decrypts, identifies, and extracts firmware parts, decompressing LZMA sections.
